name: Tenma Ootake
source:
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.

Covered in a demonic armor that unable to see his real face, what is the truth behind his helmet is still unknown.

[spoiler]Much contradicted to his immense appearance, he's relatively rational, but once it comes to fighting, his violence will be revealed and can not be stopped.[/spoiler]

"Actors acts best when they play what their roles are supposed to be——I see, so this is what the loser dogs are joking about."

[spoiler]In truth he is one of male character and a former comrade of [url=https://vndb.org/c22060]Ren[/url] in [url=https://vndb.org/v548#main]Dies Irae[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c28992]Machina/Michael Wittman[/url], after the death of [url=https://vndb.org/c29001]Marie[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c28998]Mercurius[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c22061]Reinhard Heydrich[/url], he along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by [url=https://vndb.org/c22060]Ren[/url] in order to protect what's left of her world.[/spoiler]
